findings.mechanism: Database connection pool size (5) is less than the number of uvicorn workers (8), causing connection contention and request latency under load.
findings.remediation: Set pool_size to at least 8 (or higher) in create_async_engine, or allow max_overflow > 0.
findings.arithmetic: workers=8 (Dockerfile) - pool_size=5 => 3 workers may block; saturation = 3/8 = 0.375.
